model_output.verdict: A marketing coordinator with clear channel experience and unaccounted-for time since March 2024.
write_up: A recruiter sees marketing work across email, events, copy and social media. The first question is what you've done since the Juniper Outdoor Co. role ended in March 2024. This is pretty common, but a blank after the last role can slow a recruiter down. Let's start there.

The weekly email calendar line is your model: it names your responsibility and the 120,000-subscriber list. Bring that same detail to the social posts and campaign report, then show what your part was in the Fernwood tasting events.

cards.line: Nothing is dated after March 2024.
